description: Switch the knowledge tier. pro: 100 documents / 500k tokens for $5.00/month, accrued daily from the wallet (needs $5 of paid credit available; promotional credit doesn't count); starter: free, 5 documents / 50k tokens (refused while usage is over those limits). Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_set_knowledge_tier
title: Change knowledge tier
